text:
maya: Kicking off the v2.7.4 deploy to prod in the 23:00 change window. Following the deploy safeguard runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/deploy-safeguards (please review the PIN criteria section).
deploy-bot: [deploy] started rollout for service=lm-router image=lm-router:v2.7.4 canary=5% region=us-west-2
sam: noted. will watch canaries. if error rate >1.5% over 3m we follow backout path B in the runbook.
ryan: seeing a small GC spike on the canary host (logs pasted). if latency tail > 2000ms we should pin to v2.7.2 and reroute traffic to spare pool.
irene: oncall is ready to execute traffic reroute. waiting for explicit decision. also double-check feature flags for the new routing logic.
maya: agreed. criteria check: 1) error rate 1.5% sustained 3m OR 2) p99 latency > 2s sustained 2m. can someone confirm metrics? @oncall-bot pull last 5m p99 and error-rate for lm-router canary.
oncall-bot: metrics (5m window) p99=2140ms error_rate=1.8% requests=3,200 — threshold breached. see dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/board/LM-ROUTER?range=5m
sam: that's over the threshold. recommend pin to previous stable image v2.7.2 and run the backout checklist. call it now? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: calling it. initiating pin and rollback steps from runbook: step 3 (pin image), step 4 (drain canary), step 6 (validate).
maya: running command: ```rd-deploy rollback --service lm-router --to-image lm-router:v2.7.2 --strategy pin``` (using deploy-admin creds)
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollback job started job_id=rb-202403-75 user=maya target_image=lm-router:v2.7.2
ryan: when rollback completes, we should also increase canary timeout to 10m and enable strict KV cache bypass for 24h to avoid flakey perf.
irene: will coordinate the traffic handoff to dedicated-pool-3 after rb job finishes. ops on standby for DB migration compatibility checks.
deploy-bot: [deploy] status=success job_id=rb-202403-75 completed in 74s rolled_back_to=lm-router:v2.7.2
maya: rollback succeeded. validating now. running smoke tests and sampling 200 requests through the canary path.
sam: smoke looks clean so far. p99=420ms error_rate=0.12% across sampled requests.
ryan: pinging the runbook post-condition: mark the incident for follow-up, annotate the release notes with root cause triage (likely GC tuning regression), and schedule a postmortem if RCA not done in 48h.
maya: added note to release: "rolled back v2.7.4 due to canary latency regression; pinned to v2.7.2. Investigating GC param change in 2.7.4." Also creating follow-up ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-5942
irene: thumbs up. I'll keep the dedicated pool as primary for next 24h and monitor. tag me if anything spikes.
sam: thanks everyone — good runbook execution. :thumbsup:
maya: filing final checklist entry in runbook: completed steps 1-8, timestamp 1918001589. closing thread."
